events.verdict: Durant (HOU) initiates contact to Nurkic's (UTA) head and affects his shot attempt.
Sengun (HOU) goes to, not through, Nurkic's (UTA) space as they come together during the drive.
Nurkic (UTA) is drawn into the air towards Sengun (HOU) and initiates contact with Sengun that affects his shot attempt.
Sengun (HOU) breaks the plane of the free throw line before the ball makes contact with the rim.

Replay review of the foul called on Markkanen (UTA) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Smith Jr. (HOU) pushes Markkanen into Holiday (HOU) as he attempts to set the pick. The contact from Smith Jr. causes the ensuing contact from Markkanen during the pick, and the foul is overturned to a personal foul on Smith Jr.
Filipowski (UTA) initiates contact with Thompson's (HOU) arm that affects his shot attempt.
Thompson (HOU) cleanly blocks Filipowski's (UTA) shot attempt.

Thompson (HOU) cleanly blocks Filipowski's (UTA) shot attempt before the ball touches the backboard. The ball now no longer has an opportunity to be scored and Sengun (HOU) legally makes contact with the ball after the ball touches the backboard.
Sengun (HOU) does not step out of bounds while he is in possession of the ball.
Sengun (HOU) gathers the ball on his right foot and takes two legal steps after his gather.
Filipowski (UTA) moves alongside Sengun's (HOU) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Markkanen (UTA) grazes Sengun's (HOU) arm as he defends the shot attempt.
Sengun (HOU) moves laterally into George's (UTA) path and initiates contact that affects George's SQBR.
Holiday (HOU) moves forward into George's (UTA) space and delivers contact that affects his SQBR.
Filipowski (UTA) legally contests Sengun's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Thompson (HOU) brings his arm towards Mykhailiuk (UTA) as he releases away to pursue the long rebound.
Thompson (HOU) commits a take foul on George (UTA).
Sengun (HOU) establishes himself in Markkanen's (UTA) path prior to the contact.
Sengun (HOU) and Markkanen (UTA) briefly engage and disengage following the expiration of the screen.
George (UTA) legally contests Smith Jr.'s (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Sengun (HOU) commits a take foul on Markkanen (UTA).
Thompson (HOU) establishes his left foot as his pivot, which he maintains prior to his jump shot attempt.
Filipowski (UTA) legally contests Thompson's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Thompson (HOU) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Jazz.
